title: The Small Craft Advisory
logline: Robin's two least favorite coworkers, Sandy Rivers and Patrice, fall blissfully in love two feet from her anchor chair, and Robin invents a boyfriend to dodge their double date. Barney takes the job only to learn the broadcast voice that made Patrice's knees give out, and becomes Sandy's star pupil, while the real story of how the couple met turns out to star Robin.
coldOpen: Kids, for six years your Aunt Robin worked with the two people she liked least in the world. Then, one spring, those two people fell in love. With each other.

couch.line: A man who said his own name like it was breaking news, and a woman who once laminated a sandwich.

guests.name: Gina Abruzzi
guests.role: a waitress at Bellissimo for twenty-two years who has watched every Metro News One broadcast since 2006, can recite Sandy's sign-offs from memory, and has never once noticed Robin, whom she calls 'the lady on the left'

scenes.summary: Sandy compliments Patrice on air. In the break, they reveal they've been dating for three weeks, passing notes behind Robin's back. Couple names, the marine forecast that melts Patrice's knees, and an invitation to a double date. To dodge Sandy's brother Randy, Robin invents a tall boyfriend, and Sandy breaks the news on air.

beats.line: It started on a Tuesday, during the five o'clock news.
When we come back: a pigeon in Queens who can count to four. I'm Sandy Rivers.
And I'm Robin Scherbatsky.
And Patrice? You look beautiful today.
And we're clear! Back to you, Sandy!
Sandy. In six years, you have never said one nice thing on air. About anyone else.
The public has a right to know, Robin.
We're dating! Three weeks tomorrow!
You. And Sandy.
Me and Sandy!
Sandy and me, sweetheart. Top billing.
I sit right here. Two feet from both of you. How did I not notice?
We pass notes behind your back! Every night, during the weather!
Your hair is very thick, Robin. It's basically a privacy screen.
Patrice, he once did an eleven-minute segment on his own haircut.
I've watched it forty times. The part where he turns around? I cried.
We're auditioning couple names! Monday we were Patrandy. Today we're Sandrice!
One of those is a cough syrup. The other is a side dish at a beach bar.
And every night at bedtime, he reads me the marine forecast. In the voice.
Seas two to four feet. Small craft advisory.
My knees!
Robin, we want to celebrate with my favorite person in the whole world. Double date! Friday!
She means you. My favorite person is me, but I lost the coin toss.
Oh, shoot, I'm not seeing anyone, so, rain check. Forever. Bye.
No problem! Sandy has a brother!
Randy Rivers. Morning drive, Albany. He has the voice too. Lower.
I'm seeing someone. It's new. It's serious. He's very tall.
Robin! Bring him! Friday at eight! I'll make him a name tag that just says Tall!
And we're back in three, two.
Breaking news. Robin Scherbatsky has a boyfriend. He is very tall. More at eleven.

scenes.summary: Robin breaks the news. Lily is delighted, Marshall is moved, Ted needs the couple name to be Sandrice. Robin needs a fake boyfriend; Ted volunteers, until Barney hears the voice works and claims the job. Barney imagines his broadcast-voice future; real Wendy declines. Barney becomes Robin's boyfriend and tries the voice on her.

beats.line: Sandy Rivers and Patrice are dating.
What?
That's the worst thing I've ever heard. Start at the beginning. Go slow.
Aw. Two lonely puzzle pieces, finding each other.
From two different puzzles, Marshall. And one of the pieces is a mirror.
Okay, important question. Couple name?
They're auditioning. Patrandy and Sandrice.
Sandrice. Obviously. The stressed syllable leads, the soft name lands. That's not my opinion, Robin. That's linguistics.
Ted, in the history of language, nobody has ever asked you to name a couple.
I named Marshall and Lily.
Marshily. My aunt in St. Cloud thinks it's a rash.
It gets worse. They want a double date. Friday. And I told them I have a boyfriend.
Sweetie, why would you do that?
The other option was Sandy's brother. Randy Rivers. Morning drive. Albany.
You did the right thing.
So I need a fake boyfriend. One dinner. Tall-ish.
I'll do it. Somebody has to be in that room when they pick the name.
Fair warning, Ted. He'll do the voice. He reads her the marine forecast, and her knees give out.
I'm sorry. The voice works?
On Patrice.
Sandy Rivers. A man who once interviewed his own reflection. Landed a woman. With his voice.
Robin. I'm your boyfriend.
I'm her boyfriend!
So you fought Uncle Barney to be Aunt Robin's boyfriend. Again.
Fake boyfriend, Penny. Totally different. It was a purely professional rivalry.
Think about it, Ted. This face. This suit. And that voice?
Good evening. I'm Barney Stinson. Tonight's top story: you.
Oh my.
Your place. Clear skies, a low of sixty-eight, and zero percent chance I stay for breakfast.
Say small craft advisory.
Small craft advisory.
My knees!
My knees are fine, Barney.
Give me one reason to pick you over Ted.
Ted will bring a timeline of your relationship. Laminated. With a legend.
It's a very small legend.
Fine. You're my boyfriend. But you're there for me. Not for his sinuses.
Good evening. I'm Barney Stinson. And I'm in a committed relationship.
That's the scariest sentence I've ever heard him say.

scenes.summary: A montage of Robin's week trapped between the lovebirds, and Barney's voice lessons with Sandy. Thursday night, Lily and Marshall run Couples Boot Camp. Robin admits how sure the couple is bugs her. Ted hands over a six-page memo for Sandrice. Robin sets an escape code word with Lily. Barney arrives fluent in the voice, and the fake couple aces the quiz, until Sandy calls and neither man will hang up.

beats.line: The next three days were the longest of Robin's life.
And now, back to the most beautiful woman in Manhattan. Patrice.
Cookie for my anchor! And a cookie for my anchor's neighbor!
I have a name.
From the sinuses, Barney. Smile with your sinuses.
Good. Evening.
Breaking news. I miss you.
I'm right here! Ten feet away!
Welcome to Couples Boot Camp. Rule one. Patrice will ask how you met. You need a meet-cute.
Fine. We met at a bar. He hit on me. I said no. He said, yet.
That's not a cover story. That's just what happened.
Rule two. Couples touch. Lily and I haven't let go of each other at a restaurant since 1996.
He holds my hand under the table and eats with the other one. He's terrifyingly fast.
That's what I don't get. Three weeks, and they're sure. I've used the same toothbrush for a year and I'm still not committed.
You introduce it as a toothbrush you're seeing.
Also, give this to Patrice. Six pages on why they have to be Sandrice.
Ted, nobody is going to read six pages about a nickname.
That's why there's an executive summary. It's four pages.
Lily. If it gets bad tomorrow, I text you a code word. Saskatchewan. You call with an emergency.
Of course, sweetie. I'll have my phone in my hand all night.
Good evening. I'm Barney Stinson. Sorry I'm late. Traffic on the Tappan Zee.
Oh, no. He's got the voice.
Where have you been?
Lesson five, at Sandy's. He has a recording booth in his closet, lined with his own headshots. For the acoustics.
Pop quiz. Barney. Robin's drink.
Scotch. Neat. Older than she is, which is also her type.
Robin. Barney's favorite thing.
Himself. In a suit. In a mirror. Reflected in a second mirror.
Wow. You two are actually adorable.
Take that back.
Sandy! Hey, buddy. Yeah, she's right here. Same time tomorrow? Breath work, then brunch.
No, you hang up.
No, you hang up.
My fake boyfriend is having a better relationship with Sandy Rivers than I've had with anyone.

scenes.summary: The double date at Bellissimo. Gina the waitress worships Sandy and thinks Robin is the weather. Barney ignores Robin to quiz Sandy. Lily refuses to rescue Robin by text. The couple name is final: Sandy Rivers. Patrice reveals they fell in love the day Robin yelled at them both, in Sandy's real voice. Patrice knew Barney was fake all along: he's been holding Sandy's hand. Robin admits she envies how easily Patrice loves things, and tries it on the bread. Barney's voice finally lands, on the one woman who loves Sandy Rivers.

beats.line: Robin and Barney! I knew it! I always said you two had chemistry!
You said that about me and the vending machine.
And I stand by it!
Mister Rivers. I've watched every broadcast since 2006. The haircut two-parter? I had to sit down.
The back of my head won an award, Gina. Regional.
Hi. I'm also on that show.
Oh! Are you the weather?
I sit right next to him. Every night. For six years.
The lady on the left! Love your work, hon.
Sandy, quick question. When you say more at eleven, is that the diaphragm or the soul?
The soul, Barney. The diaphragm is for weekends.

messages.text: No. This is the best night of my life.
Lily took my phone. Stay strong. Love, Marshall

beats.line: From my friend Ted. It's about your couple name. It's six pages.
Six pages! Tell Ted I'm going to laminate it. But we already picked one!
From now on, as a couple, we will be known as Sandy Rivers.
That's just your name.
It's a strong brand, Robin. Why dilute it?
I'm in there. Spiritually.
Patrice, I have to know. Which forecast got you? Marine? Five-day? Pollen?
Oh, it wasn't a forecast. It was Robin! The day she yelled at us!
Patrice. You're going to have to be more specific.
Robin, I think tonight we lead with my vacation photos.
And I made cupcakes shaped like his vacation photos!
Nobody asked either of you!
Nobody asked us.
Nobody ever asks us.
I'd ask you.
Ask me what?
Anything.
That was his real voice. First time anyone's heard it since 1987.
His real voice? I spent a week learning the fake one! I can't feel my face!
I did this. I yelled you two into love.
You're very loud, Robin. It's your gift.
Also, I know Barney isn't really your boyfriend.
How?
He's been holding Sandy's hand under the table since the bread came.
Marshall said couples touch!
It's very supportive.
If you knew, why didn't you say anything?
Because you came. That's all I wanted.
How do you do it? It took me four years to call MacLaren's my bar. You fell for Sandy Rivers in one sentence.
One word, actually.
I always thought you did it at me. The cookies. The hugs. To get under my skin.
Robin, I do it at everybody. The mailman. The pigeons. Sandy.
You're just the only one who yells back. I love that about you.
It's easy. You say it before you're sure, and then you get sure. Try it! Say you love something.
I love. This bread.
Nope. I need to lie down.
I love me. See? Easy.
Gina. Tonight's forecast: clear skies, a low of sixty-eight, and a small craft advisory.
Oh my God. You sound exactly like Sandy Rivers.
He's my protégé.
My shift ends at eleven.
More at eleven.
Kids, Aunt Robin gave the toast at their wedding. She told them she loved them. Nobody asked her to. She volunteered.
The invitations, of course, read: Sandy Rivers requests the honor of your presence at the wedding of Sandy Rivers.
